h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Maheshtala

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Maheshtala

items.pText: In Maheshtala and the neighbourhoods along the Hooghly south-west of Kolkata, much of children's outdoor life revolves around the local club and its small ground. These clubs, along with schools and municipal parks, are the main buyers of playground equipment here. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor play equipment at Vasai, near Mumbai, about 1,630 km away, and sends it to the Kolkata region by road.

A club ground usually doubles as a space for festivals, football and community events, so the playground has to share it. We help you decide where the equipment should go and how much space to keep open. Send photos of the ground and its measurements, and we will return a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

c: Place the equipment along one edge or in one corner of the ground, not in the middle, so the open space stays usable for games and pandal season. A boundary fence or low hedge between the play area and the football side keeps balls and running players away from small children.
Pieces that are fixed and simple suit a shared ground.

, see-saws and one compact multi play system give children enough to do without taking over the space. Hooghly-side ground stays damp through the monsoon, so we recommend grouting and rubber flooring. Fitness equipment for club members is on our

facts.label: Delivery and installation

items.q: Can a neighbourhood club in Maheshtala buy from FunPlay?
items.a: Yes. We supply clubs, schools and parks. Share the ground size and photos, and we will suggest where the equipment should go and send a layout drawing.

items.q: Where should the playground go on a ground used for football?
items.a: Along one edge or corner, separated by a fence or hedge, so balls and running players stay away from small children.

items.q: How is the equipment installed on damp ground?
items.a: Usually by grouting each post in concrete, with rubber flooring on a drained base. Our team or a dealer in eastern India carries out the installation.
